decisions.reason: As a technologically enhanced extension of the core decorative line, it is somewhat riskier and more niche, but with no clear evidence of results below aspiration and enough organisational slack in a broad assortment, management would likely keep it for another year.

This product fits the firm's traditional Christmas woodcraft business very closely, so absent signs of clear underperformance relative to aspirations, management would be inclined to retain it as a low-risk part of the established range.

The modern incense smoker figurine is close to the firm's established capabilities while supporting its move toward contemporary designs, so boundedly rational management would likely continue it unless early sales clearly disappointed.
